page0.text:
Slumber falls over the town.
Even though it's just past 10:00 PM, it feels like it's three in the morning.
It must be because of the serial coma incidents.
Night falls like a veil over town. The lights go out, and there aren't any people outside.

page1.text:
"So, Archer's Master unreasonably demanded that we find and investigate the Shadow."
"Yeah. We don't really have a choice, though. Are you against it, Saber?"

page2.text:
"...I told you my position on it this morning.
Now, Shirou, what leads do we have? Wandering aimlessly through the town at night could prove counterproductive."
